description: Source code implementing a navigator for CordRepBtree data structure in the Abseil library, including functions for substring extraction, skipping, and reading within a tree structure.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeNavigator
classes.description: Navigator class for traversing CordRepBtree structures, providing skip and read functionalities.

classes.name: ReadResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of a read operation, containing a CordRep pointer and length.

methods.name: Substring
methods.description: Creates a substring view of a CordRep starting at a given offset and of a specified length.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Advances the navigator by skipping a specified number of units in the tree.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a segment of data from the tree starting at a given offset for a specified length.
